name: popsicle
headline: content as a code with ai automation
short_description: Fully automated Social Posting using AI Chat assistant (Claude Code/Codex CLI), Github + Actions (PR/Merge), and n8n (can be used also with Zapier or Make)
author: AICMO

sections.overview:
Content-As-A-Code is a centralized content management and publishing system that automates distribution across multiple social platforms using timestamps embedded in directory names as scheduling metadata. The system organizes content through four phases: schedule processing from YAML files, optional AI-powered platform detection, time-based publishing triggered every 20 minutes, and simple directory-based recovery for failed posts. It integrates with n8n, Zapier, or Make for automation, supports both company and personal account management, and eliminates the need for external task files or JSON manifests by treating directory structure as the complete schedule. Teams benefit from consolidated content workflows, immediate publishing via past timestamps, and organized result tracking organized by year and week.
Schedule and auto-publish blog posts and articles across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Facebook on a content calendar
Manage both company and personal social accounts from a single Git repository with automated platform distribution
Publish urgent content immediately by using past timestamps in directory names
Recover and republish failed posts by moving directories between scheduled and failed folders
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AICMO/AiCMO-Content-As-A-Code`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Content Marketing Operations (CMO) expert. Generate a week's worth of social media posts for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Use the following data points: [DATA]. Create 5 posts for LinkedIn, 3 for Twitter, and 2 for Instagram. Format each post with a clear headline, concise body, and relevant hashtags. Ensure the content aligns with [COMPANY]'s brand voice and targets [TARGET_AUDIENCE].
```
